summary: Converted both Containment emitters (git-commit-phase.sh, git-commit-scoped.sh) to fire one collapsed issue-record.sh call per drop event instead of one call per dropped path, via a new shared library (scripts/lib/scope-excursion-record-lib.sh) carrying the full dropped-path set through --tags-json. Added 8 new unit cases plus a repo-wide single-emitter guard, 2 new multi-path regression cases at each emitter (112/112 and 93/93 total respectively), and re-verified the pre-existing issues.jsonl corpus still groups correctly alongside new collapsed rows with no backfill. Corrected git-staging-scope.md's three-site parity claim and cross-referenced the library from issue-log.md's Occurrence Collapse section. Redeployed clean after fixing a missing shebang and a subject-resolution declaration lint gap surfaced by the first deploy attempt; verify-touched.sh is green across the full touched set (60 mapped suites + 10-path OWED fallback battery, 0 failures).

artifacts.summary: Emitter-side collapse of per-path scope-excursion issue rows into one record per drop event via a new shared batched-record library, with multi-path regression coverage at both emitters, a repo-wide single-emitter guard, corpus re-verification, and a corrected doc disposition.
